review:
A fortune teller on a 6x4, 14-line grid, built around Lady Fortune – an expanding wild reel that lands with one to three multipliers at its foot. Orbs that land next to her add more, up to five per reel, and several Lady Fortune reels in one win add together.

It's less about single huge hits and more about stacking two or three expanded reels on the same spin. Rated 3/5 – moderate for Hacksaw – with a 10,000x max. A good starting point if Hacksaw usually feels too punishing.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
